# SB-1004 - Safety bulletin: airborne dust from blasting

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Hazard description
- Operations adjacent to the blast booth on line P1-L4 are generating airborne particulate that migrates into the adjoining press room. Dust accumulation on machinery and in ventilation intakes presents respiratory and ignition hazards for operators and maintenance personnel. Secondary exposure routes include transfer of dust on clothing and tools into the heat treat area associated with EQ-P1-L4-HP02. Silicate- and metallic-containing particles can abrade seals and contaminate hydraulic systems if introduced during maintenance.

Affected equipment
- Primary: EQ-P1-L4-HP02 (Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2). The lubricant part number for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is CFW-LUB-195.
- Secondary: blasting booth enclosures, local extraction ducts, press-room ventilation intakes, and nearby tooling storage.

Required controls
- Administrative: restrict non-essential entry to the press room during blasting operations. Post warning signage at access points and include SB-1034, SOP-P1-L4-04, and SOP-P1-L4-05 in shift briefings.
- Engineering: verify integrity of seals on press-room doors and ensure blast booth curtains overlap to prevent forward migration. Increase local exhaust capture at source during blasting and confirm press-room ventilation is set to negative pressure relative to the blast booth when blasting is active.
- Housekeeping: implement targeted cleaning after each blast cycle at tool benches, ventilation grilles, and machine housings using HEPA-filtered vacuum only. Do not use compressed air for cleaning contaminated surfaces.
- PPE and hygiene: require NIOSH-approved particulate respirators where airborne concentrations are present, and provide change areas to prevent cross-contamination to the heat treat area. Launder or contain contaminated clothing on site.
- Maintenance: when performing work on EQ-P1-L4-HP02, inspect hydraulic reservoirs and suction screens for contamination prior to introducing lubricant CFW-LUB-195. Document inspection and any fluid contamination per SOP-P1-L4-05.

Effective date
- This bulletin is effective immediately upon issue. Review controls and training before the next blasting schedule.
